draft.title: A signature style
card: A signature style is a way of writing or filmmaking that you can recognise across many of a creator's works. It is a pattern, not a single choice in one text.
The pattern can come from repeated subjects, such as lonely teenagers. It can also come from repeated structures, images or techniques, such as endings that circle back to the opening.

Imagine a director who often shoots scenes in warm orange light, uses long silent pauses, and tells stories about families who drift apart. Seeing these features again and again across her films is what makes her style her own.
To describe a signature style, name the feature, show it appears in more than one work, and say what effect it has on the viewer or reader.
draft.remember: A signature style is a pattern of features that repeats across a creator's works.

a.q: Which description best shows a signature style?
opts: A novelist ends most books with a letter and writes of migration
A novelist uses one simile in a single chapter of one book
A novelist writes one book that is set in a city
A novelist writes one book that has a happy ending
a.why: A signature style is a pattern that repeats across works. The first option names a repeated structure and a repeated subject. The simile option is tempting because it is a technique, but a feature used once in one text is not a pattern.
a.clue: Look for features that come back in more than one work.

b.q: Jo watches three films by director Ravi Nair. Each is set in a fishing town, opens with a shot of an empty boat, and follows a character who is leaving home. Which statement about Ravi Nair's style is best supported?
opts: The repeated setting, opening image and subject form a style
The films share a style only because they are about fishing
The empty boat shows his style, but only in the first film
The films share a style because they came out in one year
b.why: The three films repeat a setting, an opening image and a subject, so the pattern is recognisable across his work. The fishing option is tempting, but one shared topic is only part of the pattern and it leaves out the repeated image and structure.
b.clue: Count how many features repeat across the three films.

a.q: Which description best shows a signature style?
opts: A novelist's books all open with a storm at sea
A novelist uses a storm at sea once, in one of her books
A novelist's books each use new settings, forms and subjects
A novelist's one book opens and closes with a storm at sea
